schema_notes.basis: delivered = post-budget delivery slice (delivered_gold_rate). final = final ranked order handed downstream (final_recall_at_12). map = candidate-pool / score-map recall (recall_at_12). delivered and final are different metrics and are never merged.
schema_notes.shipped_default: computed mechanically for ladder receipts: true only when the arm is named baseline, runs the repo cymatix.toml, and overrides no knobs. An arm that merely re-pins the shipped value in its own config TOML reads false.
schema_notes.nulls: a null field means the source does not state that number. Nothing is estimated or back-filled.
